svg.title: Workflow Automation Platform – System Architecture
svg.desc: Webhooks from Stripe, Shopify and GitHub enter a FastAPI backend, are saved to PostgreSQL as Pending events, queued through Redis to a Celery worker that takes a Redis distributed lock, runs the automation engine (State, Chain of Responsibility with Factory steps and Strategy retries), updates the database and releases the lock with a Lua script. A React frontend polls logs every 2 seconds.
svg.text: Send events to the platform via webhooks
Saved event triggers the async task
Builds the HTTP and AI step objects

g.text: Redis SET NX PX distributed lock
Lua script releases the lock safely
